Subject: POC timeline & milestones — Cascade Corp

Hi Tom,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to learn more about Cascade's evaluation goals. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the proposed success criteria, evaluation plan, and suggested timeline so we can align on next steps. Please review and confirm or suggest edits.

Proposed Success Criteria
- 95%+ intent recognition on a 2k token average prompt set (sample attached)
- Latency under 500ms p95 for single-request flows in our staging env
- Embedding similarity recall > 0.85 for search/retrieval tests
- No PII leakage in logs and documented access controls

Evaluation Plan
- 2-week sandbox trial with 3 workloads: chat assistant, customer search, batch embeddings
- Weekly checkpoints + one mid-point quality review with your ML lead
- Final readout with business stakeholders including measurable KPIs and recommended tuning

Timeline (proposed)
- Kickoff: Week of Jun 21 (flexible — please confirm)
- Week 1: Environment access + baseline tests (Dev: @dev_patel)
- Week 2: Tuning & integration tests; mid-point review
- Final readout: week of Jul 12–16

Owners
- Redwood AE / Sponsor: Marissa Cole (me)
- Redwood SE: Dev Patel (technical onboarding, integrations)
- Redwood CSM: Marcus Lin (post-trial success plan)
- Cascade exec & ML lead: Tom Barrett / Jenna Ortiz

Action items for Cascade (please confirm who will own):
- Provide staging environment URL + API credentials (or allow Redwood test account)
- Point of contact for SSO / network access (IT)
- Representative prompt set + evaluation queries (sample attached)

Attachments: cascade_poc_scope.pdf (POC scope & sample prompts)

If that looks good, I’ll send an updated SOW draft and a DocuSign link to lock the kickoff date.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198
